| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |

| `data.effective_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The effective time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit grant expires (ISO-8601 UTC). |

A `metered` grant takes the business's `credit_config.credit_scope` when one is set. |
| `data.source` | `string` | Where the credit grant comes from. One of `purchase`, `plan_cycle`, `manual`, `restore`, `auto_top_up`. |
| `data.tax_treatment` | `string` | The credit grant's tax treatment. One of `taxed_at_purchase`, `taxed_at_use`. |
| `data.on_exhausted` | `string` | What happens when the credit is used up, for a business with blocking on. Null = not set here. One of `block`, `bill`. |

| `data.invoice` | `string` | The invoice that sold it (paid grants). |
| `data.restored_from` | `string` | The expired grant this one restores. |
| `data.auto_top_up_run` | `string` | atur_…: the automatic top-up run that sold it. |
| `data.remaining` | `object` | What is left: the sum of the grant's movements. |
| `data.metadata` | `object` | Key-value pairs you attach to the credit grant. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit grant was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit grant was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
